forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,68 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01M1MP3H7NCNK2GBQ4HR91KA2S
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8e80'
+title: 'doctor checks: the configuration, the layer paths and the transcripts'
+---
+### What
+
+cli-plan.md §5.12, rows 1 and 3. Two `Doctorable` conformances in
+`Sources/FoundationModelsACPAgent/Doctor/`.
+
+**`ConfigurationDoctor`**, category `configuration`:
+
+- The configuration loads. A `ConfigurationError` becomes one `.error`
+  whose message is the reason and whose fix names `acp-agent config
+  show`.
+- Every `ConfigurationWarning` the loader returns becomes one
+  `.warning` — an unknown section, for example — with a fix that names
+  the key and the file.
+- Each layer path of §5.10: does it exist, is it readable, is it
+  writable. A missing user or project layer is `.ok`, not a warning: the
+  stack is meant to work with no file. An unreadable one is an `.error`
+  with a `chmod` fix.
+
+**`TranscriptsDoctor`**, category `transcripts`:
+
+- The resolved transcript directory exists, or its parent is writable.
+  A directory that cannot be created is an `.error`, and its fix names
+  the `transcripts.location` key.
+- `recording.level: off` makes this component report `isApplicable ==
+  false`, so it stays silent rather than checking a directory nothing
+  will write.
+
+Both take the resolved `AgentConfiguration` and the `DotfolderStack`
+through their initializer. Neither reads the process environment
+directly, so a test can drive them with a temporary stack.
+
+- [ ] `ConfigurationDoctor`, with the load, the warnings and the paths
+- [ ] `TranscriptsDoctor`, with `isApplicable` for `recording: off`
+- [ ] Register both in the doctor component list
+
+### Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] A stack with no file gives all `.ok` rows.
+- [ ] A `config.yaml` with an unknown section gives one `.warning` that
+      names the section.
+- [ ] A `config.yaml` with an unknown key in a known section gives one
+      `.error`.
+- [ ] A read-only transcripts parent gives one `.error` with a fix.
+- [ ] With `recording.level: off`, `TranscriptsDoctor` contributes no
+      rows.
+- [ ] Every `.warning` and `.error` carries a non-nil `fix`.
+
+### Tests
+
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsACPAgentTests/Doctor/ConfigurationDoctorTests.swift`:
+      one test per case above, each against a temporary dotfolder stack.
+- [ ] `TranscriptsDoctorTests`: the writable case, the unwritable case,
+      and the `isApplicable` case.
+- [ ] A test walks every check these two produce and asserts that no
+      `.warning` or `.error` has a nil `fix`.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes.
+
+### Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
